class.name: PuertsScriptValue
class.description: A valid wrapper keeps its script value reachable but does not keep the environment alive. Disposal invalidates it permanently.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns true while this wrapper and its environment are live.

method.name: is_null
method.description: Returns true for a script null or an invalid wrapper.

method.name: is_undefined
method.description: Returns true for script undefined or an invalid wrapper.

method.name: is_bool
method.description: Returns true for a script boolean.

method.name: is_int
method.description: Returns true for an integer according to the backend.

method.name: is_float
method.description: Returns true for a floating-point value according to the backend.

method.name: is_string
method.description: Returns true for a script string.

method.name: is_binary
method.description: Returns true for a script binary value.

method.name: is_object
method.description: Returns true for a script object.

method.name: is_function
method.description: Returns true for a script function.

method.name: to_bool
method.description: Reads a boolean with the backend accessor; returns false when invalid.

method.name: to_int
method.description: Reads a signed 64-bit integer. V8 and Node.js require BigInt and return 0 for Number; use to_native or to_float for Number values.

method.name: to_float
method.description: Reads a floating-point value; returns 0.0 when invalid.

method.name: to_string
method.description: Reads a string; returns an empty String when invalid.

method.name: to_binary
method.description: Copies script binary data to PackedByteArray; returns an empty array when invalid.

method.name: to_native
method.description: Converts primitives and supported native values to Variant. Ordinary script objects and functions remain wrapped.

method.name: unwrap_native
method.description: Returns the wrapped Godot value, or null when invalid, freed, or non-native.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Returns the named property as a wrapper; failures report through the environment callback.

method.name: set_property
method.description: Converts and assigns a Variant to the named property; cross-environment values are rejected.

method.name: call
method.description: Calls the wrapped function with args and returns its result wrapper, or null on failure.

method.name: call_method
method.description: Calls the named method with args using the wrapped object as receiver, or returns null on failure.
